oracle: Compare actual canonical/key/audio/answer/config identity and independent operation trace with no source records; source-context unavailable affects only selected action.
positive_setup: No external source is acquired and empirical difficulty is unrated
negative_setup: An operator explicitly selects an unacquired source as generation context
positive_expectation: the selected actual LLM/speech owners use the saved artifacts and return native scores and category-targeted advice without external acquisition
negative_expectation: the action reports that source unavailable, offers an explicit independent/available-source choice and does not silently replace it or block unrelated independent generation

oracle: Compare complete native-member/field inventory, transformation bindings, actual source origin/counts and original source list independently of normalized/completeness output.
positive_setup: An actual permitted archive has complete observed raw members and some native instrument fields are unbound
negative_setup: A source is partial, a URL replaces media bytes or mirror counts differ from published expectations
positive_expectation: raw fields/members survive, unbound semantics remain raw_only, no private API or study UI is required and actual source/representation/count provenance is retained
negative_expectation: the report exposes its missing/unknown/discrepant scope without calling it complete, dropping fields or substituting another release; unrelated generated use continues

oracle: Compare selected-case/native dispatch/Lab observations against affected properties and actual reference populations; fixture-only or unselected scopes cannot establish actual/full claims.
positive_setup: An authorized AI increment selects meaningful constructed or permitted references for a concrete LLM/speech binding
negative_setup: Only fixture/static or selected-binding evidence exists and other categories/voices/populations are unobserved
positive_expectation: actual Lab/native observations cover the selected positive/negative cases, failures and circular-reference limits; no732population or participant recruitment is required
negative_expectation: the claim remains limited or incomplete; no artifact fixture, intended sound or small selected population is represented as actual full-scope behavior
